title: Supplementary Supply and Budget Adjustments (FY 2021) Bill
what_it_is: Supplementary Supply and Budget Adjustments (FY 2021) Bill

sections.label: Supplementary Main Estimates Expenditure Approval
sections.summary: The House approved additional sums in the Supplementary Main Estimates of Expenditure for 1 April 2021 to 31 March 2022, as amended in Paper Cmd 7 of 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The additional sums have been approved by the House in the Supplementary Main Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2021 to 31 March 2022, as amended, contained in Paper Cmd 7 of 2021.
